commands_run: clan patch-html test-sandbox/happy/heavy/h1-clan-rep3/work/doc.clan test-sandbox/happy/heavy/h1-clan-rep3/work/patch-bar-zoho.html --agent chart-agent --action "shrink Zoho bar to reflect lower cost" --rationale "Price drop from hop 1 reflected in chart"

errors.what: First patch attempt used wrong frontmatter keys (selector/action instead of patch_selector/patch_action), causing append rather than replace — duplicate bar-zoho elements created, integrity check failed
errors.recovered_by: Restored doc.clan from hop-05 snapshot, corrected frontmatter keys in patch file, re-applied patch successfully

problems_and_friction: The patch-html frontmatter key names differ from the CLI flag names (patch_selector vs --selector), which is not obvious from --help alone and required reading the embedded spec. The first attempt created a duplicate element instead of replacing, breaking integrity and requiring a snapshot restore. After reading the spec the correct keys (patch_selector, patch_action) worked first try.
context_understood: Hop 06 applies a chart update making Zoho's bar shorter (y=78, height=82) to reflect it becoming the cheapest option after the hop-01 price-drop change.
